t: I wish i knew this before : r/printers
s: July 10, 2021 - Stay away from the Rollo's, and any other thermal printers on Amazon with CAPITAL LETTERS in their name, they are crap. This will cost a little more but save you tons of hassle/money in the long run. Dymo's and similar products use proprietary consumables so keep this in mind. The Zebra will give flexibility, tried and true and comes with way better support and drivers. This is a 4" 200dpi printer that can do roll or fan fold materials. The "d" model is direct thermal and "t" is thermal transfer so price accordingly.
